name: AI Recipe: IAM App Prototype
description: Claude builds a runnable identity-and-access-management tool prototype (certification triage, lifecycle tracing, role mining, break-glass review, access-request UX…) on synthetic data, rotating ten IAM pain areas so the catalogue stays balanced. Vendor-neutral; speaks SCIM, OIDC and SAML, never one product.
